# UC47 — Privilege A2A three-deep agent chain

**Track:** tools  
**Maturity:** ✅ `works`  


## Buyer Story

Platform teams want agents to hand work to other agents without losing control of who may call whom, or what crosses each hand-off.

## PingOne Solution

A main agent calls a middle agent, which calls a specialist. Every hop goes through the PingOne Privilege AI Gateway with that agent’s own key, so scope, policy and guardrail are checked between each pair of agents.

## How to Run

**Trigger:** Trigger (link): `{"type":"link","path":"/dashboard","label":"Run the agent chain"}`  
**Expected outcome:** `A2A_AGENT_CHAIN`

## What to Say

> Run the chain and watch the reel: each hand-off stops at the gateway first. Then run the injection and the ungranted-agent variants to see a hop refused, and the poisoned Agent Card variant (C) to see the gateway block a reply that carries a hostile agent’s text.
